lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: Vin. Vin! Look at me. He's gone, and they're coming for everyone who looks like they understood what they just saw.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: I could have reached him. I was right there —

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: You were right where he wanted you: alive. The Inquisitors are off the platform. Keep them busy until Breeze gets the crowd moving, then run for the west alley.
